target.title: Fix Gemini helper timeout reliability
target.body:
## Summary

- Make Gemini package-discovery helpers wait synchronously for Foundation to reap normal exits, with timeout termination owned by an independent concurrent timer queue.
- Mark the timeout before terminating the process group, removing the race between exit observation and timeout classification.
- Close the parent's duplicated pipe writers, return after the first complete output line, and resolve `fnm` from the effective environment path before the login-shell fallback.
- Cover delayed success, first-line extraction, prompt no-output failure, inherited pipe writers, environment-path resolution, and ignored-SIGTERM escalation.
- Preserve five minutes of macOS shard headroom for the repository's observed 35-minute test-step boundary.
- Document the user-visible reliability fix in the changelog.

## Proof

- `swift test --filter GeminiStatusProbeAPITests` — 19/19 passed on exact head, including the hard-timeout, early no-output, and first-line completion cases.
- `make check` — repository guards, 145 documentation links, 22 site locales, SwiftFormat, and SwiftLint passed; 0 violations across 1,246 linted files.
- Fresh autoreview — clean, no accepted/actionable findings (0.86 confidence).
- Earlier freshly built CLI live proof — `CodexBarCLI usage --provider gemini --format json` exited 0 and returned one Gemini provider record with usage and no error; identity values were not printed.
- Installed helper proof — `fnm current` returned `v25.8.1`, and `fnm exec --using v25.8.1 npm root -g` returned the active global package root.

## Risk

Low. The runtime change is provider-scoped; the helper remains synchronous and bounded, escalates to hard process-group termination after the deadline, and has direct success and failure-path coverage. The CI-only change adds timeout headroom without changing test selection or pass criteria.
